text:
maria.h: incident-bot paging: High error rate observed on embeddings->reranker pipeline for customer 'AtlasSearch'. Errors spiked ~09:12 UTC, 5% of requests failing. Tagging oncall.
incident-bot: @tim.o you are now on-call for incidents in #incidents (auto-assigned).
sre-bot: alert: rerank-batch-endpoint returned 500 x 120 in last 5m; 99th latency increased to 2.3s.
tim.o: I'm on it. Quick ask: do we know if this is batch endpoint only or affecting streaming endpoints too?
maria.h: early telemetry shows batch endpoint (rerank-batch-v2) error rate up; streaming gen and embeddings standalone look nominal.
lexi: I see a downstream scorer 502 cascade in logs referencing vector length mismatch. Pasting minimal log: ```ERROR scorer_service: panic: expected vector len 768, got 512 at /svc/scorer/encode.go:87```
ajay: who pushed scorer v1.3.1 yesterday? I have CI deploy logs showing a deploy at 02:45 UTC.
emma: that deploy was a config change to support mixed-quant models, maybe defaulting to 512 dim for some model families.
tim.o: hypothesis 1: scorer started accepting a new embed shape (512) but reranker batch collator still assumes 768 -> shape mismatch -> scorer rejects batch -> 500s.
maria.h: hypothesis 2: some upstream model switching logic routed a subset of requests to a 512-d quantized model (cost optimization) without schema compatibility checks.
lexi: I'm pulling request traces now. Link: https://redwood.prod/traces/1990001112-rca (internal)
lexi: sample request trace shows embedder A returned shape 512 for model rdm-small-q4_512 at 09:10:45, while batch collator expected 768.
tim.o: mitigation plan: 1) revert scorer accepting 512 until collator updated 2) add quick gate in routing to avoid rdm-small-q4_512 for reranker path 3) roll a hotfix to collator to validate vector sizes. Prioritize gating to reduce customer impact.
ajay: can we hotpatch routing rules? That is lower risk than touching scorer.
emma: yes, we can add a routing denylist for model id rdm-small-q4_512 in the reranker policy within 10m. Doing a dry-run now.
incident-bot: Action: routing denylist applied for model rdm-small-q4_512 on reranker path by emma at 09:23 UTC (dry-run -> applying in 30s).
lexi: after applying denylist, error rate dropped from 5% -> 0.2% within a minute. We still see occasional 500s for older traces.
tim.o: good. escalate: start postmortem timeline. Who has logs we should attach?
maria.h: I'll assemble timeline: - 02:45 UTC deploy scorer v1.3.1 (config change) - 08:58 UTC routing experiment enabled rdm-small model in canary - 09:10 UTC first failed request with 512->panic in scorer - 09:12 UTC alert -> paging triggered - 09:23 UTC routing denylist applied - 09:25 UTC error rate dropped.
ajay: adding log excerpts: ```[09:10:45] embedder: model=rdm-small-q4_512 vector_len=512 request_id=abc123
[09:10:45] collator: expected_len=768 batch_id=xyz789 request_ids=[abc123,...]
[09:10:45] scorer: panic: vector len mismatch -> 500 response
```
emma: customer impact: AtlasSearch reports degraded rerank results for 3% of queries between 09:10-09:23 UTC. I flagged CS to contact them; they confirmed higher error rate but no data loss.
lexi: open actions/todos: - add input validation in collator (reject with 400 + metric) - add schema check in routing experiments to prevent mismatched models on rerank path - revert scorer config to be strict until collator supports variable dims - add e2e test for embedding dim compatibility - postmortem doc.
tim.o: I'm assigning owners: collator validation -> lexi, routing experiments gating -> emma, scorer revert -> ajay, customer comms -> maria.h. Please update status here.
ajay: reverting scorer config now. ETA 12m for canary rollback and validation.
lexi: starting collator PR for validation, adding fail-fast and better logging. Small patch, will request review in 20m.
emma: routing rule fully applied and verified across 3 regions. No rollout to rerank for rdm-small-q4_512.
maria.h: thanks. I'm drafting an initial incident summary for execs: root cause: routing experiment introduced model variant with 512-dim embeddings into reranker path; scorer and collator lacked compatibility checks leading to 500s. Impact: AtlasSearch experienced ~13m window of elevated errors and degraded reranks for subset of queries. Mitigation: denied model, rolled back scorer config, and will add validation.
incident-bot: incident severity updated to Sev2 by tim.o.
tim.o: tracking hypotheses: H1 (routing->shape mismatch) = confirmed; H2 (scorer config auto-accept change) = partial; H3 (batch collator lacks validation) = confirmed.
ajay: rollback complete on canary, watching metrics. No further 500s in canary.
lexi: PR opened: collator/validate-vector-len (#4982). Tests included.
maria.h: customer comms: CS sent proactive note, offered extra quota for the incident window. Waiting on customer reply.
tim.o: next steps for RCA doc: timeline, root cause, mitigation, remediation timeline, owners, postmortem review scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Anyone object?
emma: ack.
ajay: ack.
lexi: ack.
incident-bot: incident closed to active mitigation. Follow-up: attach logs/traces to the postmortem doc.
maria.h: I'll create the postmortem doc and link logs. Putting owner as maria.h. Will include the above timeline and actions.
end of thread.
